AboutUs:
Our Purpose

HappyPrancer is designed for busy adults and everyday movers who want a consistent, uplifting routine from home. When busy schedules make traveling to a gym impractical, our live online sessions bring supportive movement directly to you. Whether you are stepping into your very first class or looking for an enjoyable way to stay active, our live yoga, Zumba, and BWORKZ dance-fitness sessions are welcoming and beginner-friendly.

Founder's Story

HappyPrancer started with our founder, PK, who experienced firsthand the difficulty of balancing fitness with a demanding schedule. Discovering Zumba provided an accessible way to stay active and connected with others. When fitness clubs closed during the pandemic, PK founded HappyPrancer to share that experience, bringing instructor-led dance fitness and yoga to members through live online sessions.

How to Join

  1. Choose a plan. Select the online or hybrid membership that fits your routine.
  2. Create your account. Complete your registration in just a few quick steps.
  3. Open the schedule and join your live class through Zoom. View upcoming sessions on your dashboard and connect directly with instructors and members.

PrivacyPolicy.content:
HappyPrancer ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, process, share, and protect your information when you visit https://happyprancer.com, register for an account, subscribe to our fitness memberships, join our virtual classes, or interact with our services.

By accessing or using HappyPrancer, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with our practices, please discontinue using our website and services.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy

PrivacyPolicy.content:
We collect information directly from you when you create an account, purchase a subscription, attend classes, or communicate with us, as well as limited technical information automatically:

• Account & Profile Information: When registering, you provide your name, email address, phone number, and optional profile image. If you join via referral, referral link data is associated with your account.
• Authentication Data: Passwords and authentication tokens managed securely through AWS Cognito, or basic identity tokens if you authenticate through Google.
• Activity & Engagement Data: Class attendance records, practice streaks, instructor ratings, and accumulated Z Points.
• Subscription & Payment Records: Subscription plan selections, payment transaction IDs, gateway order/subscription IDs, amounts paid, payment dates, and subscription statuses (active, paused, cancelled).
• Technical & Usage Data: Basic device and browser information, IP addresses, and page analytics collected via Google Tag Manager to maintain site performance and security.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Information We Collect

PrivacyPolicy.content:
We use the personal information we collect for the following specific purposes:

• Providing and managing your HappyPrancer account and class access.
• Authenticating your identity and preventing unauthorized account access.
• Delivering live online dance, Zumba, and yoga sessions via Zoom.
• Processing subscription payments, renewals, cancellations, and invoices.
• Calculating Z Points, practice streaks, and maintaining the All-Time Leaderboard.
• Facilitating instructor ratings and referral reward benefits.
• Sending essential account communications, class schedule notifications, and service updates.
• Complying with applicable legal, accounting, and regulatory obligations.

We do not sell, rent, trade, or monetize your personal information to third-party marketing companies.
PrivacyPolicy.title: How We Use Information

PrivacyPolicy.content:
HappyPrancer provides sign-up and login capabilities using Google Authentication (Google Identity Services, Google One Tap, and AWS Cognito federated sign-in):

• Information Received from Google: When you sign in with Google, Google provides HappyPrancer with your basic profile information consisting of your full name, email address, and an authentication ID token.
• Information Stored by HappyPrancer: HappyPrancer stores your name and email address in our AWS Cognito User Pool and DynamoDB database to establish your user account and profile.
• Scope of Access: Google authentication is used strictly for identity verification and account creation. HappyPrancer does not request or access any other Google account permissions or services, such as Google Drive, Google Contacts, Google Calendar, or Gmail.
• Phone Number Verification: Because Google does not provide a phone number, users signing up through Google are prompted to provide a contact number for class schedule updates and account verification.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Google Authentication & Sign-In

PrivacyPolicy.content:
Our live virtual fitness, Zumba, and yoga sessions are conducted through Zoom Video Communications:

• Meeting Links: Instructors and administrators create Zoom meeting links that are stored on HappyPrancer and displayed in the authenticated Member Dashboard under Upcoming Sessions.
• Direct Redirection: When you click "Join on Zoom", you are redirected to the Zoom application or web client in a separate browser tab. HappyPrancer does not embed the meeting client or transmit your personal profile data to Zoom via API. Your use of Zoom is subject to Zoom's own Privacy Statement and Terms of Service.
• Class Recordings: Instructors and administrators may attach recording links to past sessions in the Member Dashboard ("Previous Sessions") for on-demand review by subscribed members.
• Recording Practices Notice: Routine recording practices, participant camera/audio recording consent, and recording storage retention schedules require formal business policy confirmation.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Online Classes & Zoom Integration

PrivacyPolicy.content:
All financial transactions and recurring subscription memberships are processed through verified third-party payment gateways:

• Payment Gateways: We use Razorpay for domestic transactions in Indian Rupees (INR) and PayPal for international transactions and memberships.
• No Direct Card Storage: HappyPrancer never collects, processes, or stores credit card numbers, debit card numbers, CVV security codes, card expiration dates, or net banking passwords on our servers. All financial details are entered directly into the secure, PCI-DSS compliant checkout interfaces of Razorpay or PayPal.
• Data Stored by HappyPrancer: HappyPrancer stores transaction metadata returned by the payment processor, including payment ID, order ID, subscription ID, payment date, billing amount, currency, and subscription status (active, paused, or cancelled).
• Use of Payment Data: Stored transaction records are used exclusively to activate subscription access, manage plan upgrades/downgrades, process eligible refunds in accordance with our Refund Policy, generate invoices, and calculate instructor referral cashouts.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Payments & Subscriptions

PrivacyPolicy.content:
HappyPrancer operates a public All-Time Leaderboard available to all website visitors at https://happyprancer.com/leaderboard:

• Publicly Visible Information: If you participate in classes, refer members, or rate instructors, your total accumulated Z Points contribute to your leaderboard ranking. The public leaderboard displays:
  - Your display Name (or "Member" / account status such as "Inactive" where applicable)
  - Total Z Points earned to date
  - All-Time Rank
  - Profile Picture (or initials avatar)
  - Current active practice streak (e.g., "🔥 3d")
• Strictly Confidential Information: Your email address, phone number, billing records, payment history, attendance logs, and internal Cognito/user IDs are never shown on the public leaderboard.
• Account Disambiguation: Historical or inactive accounts retain their earned points and ranking on the All-Time Leaderboard and are clearly disambiguated with an "Inactive" indicator without exposing private account identifiers.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Public Leaderboard & Z Points

PrivacyPolicy.content:
We retain your personal data, subscription records, and activity history for as long as your account remains active or as necessary to:

• Provide ongoing class access and platform features.
• Maintain accurate historical standings on the All-Time Leaderboard.
• Track accumulated Z Points and referral reward associations.
• Maintain statutory business, tax, and accounting records related to subscriptions.
• Resolve disputes and enforce our platform agreements.

Formal retention schedules: Specific automated data retention periods and deletion schedules for inactive accounts and session logs require business and legal approval.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Data Retention

PrivacyPolicy.content:
We respect your right to control your personal information:

• Account Deletion Process: HappyPrancer provides an administrative user deletion workflow on the backend (/admin/delete-user) to remove or deactivate user accounts and associated profile records.
• Submitting a Deletion Request: Self-service account deletion is currently not available directly in the user profile interface. Members and users may request the deletion or deactivation of their account and personal data at any time by contacting our administration team.
• Official Deletion & Privacy Contact: To request account deletion, data access, or correction of your personal information, please email our verified administrative contact at admin@happyprancer.com.
• Request Handling: Upon receiving a verified request from your registered email address, we will process the deletion or deactivation in accordance with operational procedures and legal retention requirements.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Data Deletion & Privacy Requests

PrivacyPolicy.content:
We share your information only with verified third-party service providers necessary to operate the HappyPrancer platform:

• Amazon Web Services (AWS): Cloud infrastructure hosting our application, DynamoDB databases, Cognito user authentication, S3 media storage, and CloudFront content delivery.
• Google: Identity authentication via Google OAuth 2.0 / One Tap, and website analytics via Google Tag Manager.
• Zoom Video Communications: Third-party video conferencing service for conducting live fitness and dance sessions.
• Razorpay: Payment gateway processing Indian Rupee (INR) transactions and recurring subscriptions.
• PayPal: Payment gateway processing international currency transactions and memberships.

All service providers are bound to handle personal data only as required to perform their designated functions on our behalf and in compliance with security standards.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Third-Party Service Providers

PrivacyPolicy.content:
HappyPrancer uses cookies and browser storage technologies:

• Essential Cookies: Used to maintain your authenticated login session, preserve temporary navigation parameters, and ensure secure platform access.
• Browser Session Storage: Used temporarily during the signup/payment transition to preserve selected subscription plans and referral tokens across authentication redirects.
• What We Do Not Do: Our website does not use cookies to track items in an e-commerce shopping cart, nor do we use tracking cookies to sell identifiable customer profiles to third parties.
• Managing Cookies: You can modify your browser settings to decline cookies; however, disabling essential cookies will prevent you from logging into your account or accessing subscription features.
PrivacyPolicy.title: Cookies & Browser Technologies

PrivacyPolicy.content:
If you have any questions, concerns, feedback, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact us:

• Email: admin@happyprancer.com
• Address: C52, Banpur, Khordha, Odisha, India, 752031
• Official Website: https://happyprancer.com
PrivacyPolicy.title: Contact Us

Refund.content: Thank you for choosing HappyPrancer for your virtual dance workout needs! We are committed to providing you with the best experience possible. Please carefully read the following cancellation and refund policy, which applies to both Indian and outside India users.
Refund.heading: Cancellation/Refund Policy

Refund.content: We charge {INDIAN_PRICE} per month for Indian users and {INTERNATIONAL_PRICE} per month for outside India users. We may run periodic discount offers. The subscription fee is charged on a monthly basis and is an automated recurring payment
Refund.heading: Subscription Fees

Refund.content: You can cancel your subscription at any time without incurring any cancellation fees. To cancel your subscription, please log in to your account and follow the cancellation process. Your subscription will be canceled immediately.
Refund.heading: Cancellation

Refund.content:
If the payment for your subscription fails or if we receive confirmation from the bank, we will offer a refund. We may also offer refunds in certain other circumstances, at our discretion. Refunds will be issued to the original payment method used to purchase the subscription.

      In the event of cancellation of the subscription, you will be refunded the remaining subscription amount for the unused portion of the month only if you cancel the subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the billing cycle. However, if you have taken advantage of any discount offers at the time of purchase, the refund amount will be calculated based on the discounted amount paid.

    If you cancel your subscription after the first month or in the middle of the month, you will not be eligible for a refund for the subscription fee paid for that month. However, you will not be charged for any subsequent months
Refund.heading: Refunds

Refund.content: From time to time, we may offer periodic discount offers on our subscription fees. If you purchase a subscription during a discount offer period, the subscription fee will be charged at the discounted rate for the duration of the offer period. If you cancel your subscription during the offer period, you will not be eligible for a refund.
Refund.heading: Periodic Discount Offers

Refund.content: If you have any questions or concerns regarding our cancellation and refund policy, please contact us at admin@happyprancer.com. We are always happy to assist you in any way .
Refund.heading: Contact Us
